results.name: Ruzafa
results.character: Vibrant, hipster, artistic, mixing tradition and modernity
results.what_to_do_there: Wander the colorful streets to see street art, browse quirky boutiques, sip coffee in trendy cafés, visit the Mercadillo de Ruzafa market for vintage finds
results.why_it_is_special: Known for its lively creative scene, it blends historic architecture with a youthful, multicultural vibe, attracting locals and artists

results.name: El Carmen
results.character: Historic heart, open‑air museum of street art, lively nightlife
results.what_to_do_there: Explore narrow medieval lanes, admire murals, hop between tapas bars and cafés, climb the Serranos and Quart towers, visit the Cathedral (Holy Grail)
results.why_it_is_special: The oldest part of Valencia, it juxtaposes centuries‑old stone with contemporary graffiti, offering an authentic local atmosphere

results.name: Benimaclet
results.what_to_do_there: Meet locals at Plaza de Benimaclet, enjoy poetry nights and live music in bars like La Murta, browse the Saturday market, admire ever‑changing murals
results.why_it_is_special: Retains a tight‑knit community spirit from its former village roots while hosting a vibrant student and artistic scene

results.name: El Cabanyal
results.character: Seaside neighbourhood with colorful houses, maritime heritage, up‑and‑coming
results.what_to_do_there: Stroll historic streets, admire the colourful façades, visit Casa Montaña for traditional tapas, enjoy cultural events at La Fábrica de Hielo and Naves, relax on the nearby beach
results.why_it_is_special: Once a poor fishing district, it now offers a blend of authentic maritime culture, colourful architecture and a growing creative scene

results.name: Arrancapins
results.character: Authentic, family‑friendly, old‑town charm with renovated buildings
results.what_to_do_there: Walk the central plaza, shop in local stores, admire the renovated Finca Roja, enjoy the quiet residential atmosphere
results.why_it_is_special: Preserves a genuine Valencian neighbourhood feel, with traditional shops and a sense of community away from tourist crowds
